step1.title: Step 1. Create Your Dynopay Account
step1.desc: Sign up using your business email and complete the initial account setup. Once registered, you’ll get access to the Dynopay dashboard where all payments, wallets, and settings are managed.

step2.title: Step 2. Complete Basic Business Setup
step2.desc: Add your business details, such as company name and operating country. Depending on your use case and volume, Dynopay may request additional verification later, but you can start testing payments right away.

step3.title: Step 3. Choose Supported Cryptocurrencies
step3.desc: Select which cryptocurrencies and networks you want to accept. Dynopay supports multiple assets and chains, allowing you to choose options that best fit your customers and transaction fees.

step4.title: Step 4. Set Up Your First Payment
step4.heading: You can accept payments in several ways:
step4.footer: For most businesses, payment links or invoices are the fastest way to get started.

step5.title: Step 5. Receive and Track Payments
step5.desc: Once a customer completes a payment, the transaction appears in your dashboard with real-time status updates. You can track confirmations, amounts, and network details in one place.

step6.title: Step 6. Configure Payouts
step6.heading: Decide where your funds should go:
step6.point1: Keep funds in your connected crypto wallet
step6.point2: Set up automatic or manual payouts
step6.footer: Payout availability depends on the selected currency and network.

step7.title: Step 7. Test Before Going Live
step7.desc: We recommend running a small test transaction to make sure everything works as expected before sharing payment links with customers.

gettingStarted.intro: Dynopay helps businesses accept crypto payments without dealing with complex blockchain mechanics. This guide walks you through the basic steps to get up and running.
